title: Reading Practice Test 04 – Retail & E-commerce
description: Đề luyện Reading theo cấu trúc đề thi TOEIC (IIG Việt Nam), rút gọn 28 câu: Part 5 (10) · Part 6 (4, có câu điền cả câu) · Part 7 (14: thông báo, trò chuyện trực tuyến, thông cáo báo chí, ba đoạn liên kết). Chủ đề: bán lẻ, mua sắm trực tuyến, bảo hành.

questions.content: Online orders placed before 2:00 P.M. are ------- shipped on the same day.
questions.explanation: Trạng từ đứng giữa 'are' và phân từ 'shipped' để bổ nghĩa → 'usually'.

questions.content: The store manager ------- all employees to attend the training session on customer service.
questions.explanation: Chỉ 'encourage + O + to V' đúng cấu trúc. 'suggest/recommend' không dùng với O + to V (dùng 'suggest that…'); 'insist' đi với 'on'.

questions.content: Customers who are not ------- satisfied with their purchase may return it within 30 days.
questions.explanation: Trạng từ bổ nghĩa cho tính từ 'satisfied' → 'completely satisfied' (hoàn toàn hài lòng).

questions.content: The spring collection will be available in stores ------- online starting March 1.
questions.explanation: Nối hai cụm tương đương 'in stores' và 'online' với nghĩa 'cũng như' → 'as well as'.

questions.content: The new checkout system is ------- faster than the old one.
questions.explanation: Nhấn mạnh so sánh hơn dùng 'much/far/a lot' → 'much faster'. 'very' không đứng trước so sánh hơn; 'more faster' sai.

questions.content: Shoppers ------- purchases exceed $100 will receive free delivery.
questions.explanation: Chỗ trống đứng trước danh từ 'purchases' và chỉ sở hữu (đơn hàng của người mua) → 'whose'.

questions.content: Due to high demand, the limited-edition sneakers sold out ------- two hours.
questions.explanation: 'within + khoảng thời gian' = trong vòng. 'since' đi với mốc thời gian.

questions.content: The marketing team is analyzing customer ------- to improve the online shopping experience.
questions.explanation: Sau động từ 'analyzing' cần danh từ làm tân ngữ; 'customer feedback' = phản hồi của khách hàng.

questions.content: Ms. Tran was promoted to regional manager ------- her outstanding sales record.
questions.explanation: Theo sau là cụm danh từ 'her outstanding sales record' → giới từ 'because of'. 'because' cần mệnh đề.

questions.content: Please keep your receipt, as it ------- for all returns and exchanges.
questions.explanation: Hoá đơn 'được yêu cầu' (bị động) → 'is required'.

groups.passage:
Dear Ms. Grant,

Thank you for your recent order from HomeStyle Online. We are writing to let you know that the dining chairs you ordered are temporarily out of stock. Our supplier ---131--- us that new stock will arrive by August 20.

We ---132--- that this delay may be inconvenient. You may choose to wait for the chairs, or you may cancel this part of your order for a full refund. ---133---.

As a thank-you for your patience, we have added a 15% discount code to your account, which can be used on your next ---134---.

Sincerely,
HomeStyle Online Customer Care

questions.explanation: Nhà cung cấp đã báo (việc vừa xảy ra, kết quả liên quan hiện tại) → hiện tại hoàn thành 'has informed'.
Chủ ngữ 'We' + động từ chia hiện tại đơn → 'understand'.

options.A: The rest of your order will be shipped today.
options.C: Chairs make up most of our sales.

questions.explanation: Chỉ phần ghế bị thiếu hàng; câu hợp lý thông báo phần còn lại của đơn vẫn được giao hôm nay.
Sau 'your next' cần danh từ; 'your next purchase' = lần mua tiếp theo. 'purchaser' là người mua – sai nghĩa.

groups.passage:
ATTENTION CUSTOMERS

Our fitting rooms are being renovated and will be closed from July 1 to July 7. During this time, you may try on items in the temporary fitting area next to the shoe department on the second floor.

We have also extended our return period from 30 to 45 days for all clothing purchased this week.

Thank you for your understanding!
Management, Carlton Fashion

questions.content: What is the purpose of the notice?
questions.explanation: Phòng thử đồ đóng cửa sửa chữa, khách dùng khu thử đồ tạm → thông báo sắp xếp tạm thời.

questions.content: What is offered to customers this week?
questions.explanation: 'We have also extended our return period from 30 to 45 days' → thêm thời gian đổi trả.

groups.passage:
ShopNow Electronics – Live Chat

Mina (Agent) 10:14 A.M.
Hello! How can I help you today?

Rob Evans 10:15 A.M.
Hi. I ordered wireless headphones last week. The tracking page says they were delivered yesterday, but I never received them.

Mina (Agent) 10:16 A.M.
I'm sorry to hear that. Could you give me your order number?

Rob Evans 10:16 A.M.
It's SN44718.

Mina (Agent) 10:18 A.M.
Thank you. The driver's notes say the package was left with your building manager. Have you checked with him?

Rob Evans 10:20 A.M.
Oh, I didn't know that. He's out until this afternoon.

Mina (Agent) 10:21 A.M.
If it isn't there, please contact us again, and we'll send you a replacement at no charge.

questions.content: Why did Mr. Evans contact ShopNow Electronics?

options.A: He has not received an item.
options.D: He wants to cancel an order.

questions.explanation: '…they were delivered yesterday, but I never received them.'

questions.content: According to the agent, where was the package left?
questions.explanation: 'The package was left with your building manager.'

questions.content: What will ShopNow Electronics do if the package cannot be found?

options.B: Ship a new item free of charge

questions.explanation: 'We'll send you a replacement at no charge.'

groups.passage:
FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE
BrightMart Launches Same-Day Delivery in Five Cities

CHICAGO, March 3 – BrightMart, one of the country's largest home-goods retailers, announced today that customers in five cities can now receive online orders on the same day they are placed. The service is available in Chicago, Denver, Atlanta, Seattle, and Boston for orders placed before noon. [1]

The launch follows a successful six-month trial in Chicago, during which online sales rose by 22 percent. [2] "Our customers told us that speed matters as much as price," said CEO Linda Farrow. "This service addresses that need directly."

Same-day delivery costs $7.99 per order, but it is free for members of BrightMart Plus, the company's annual membership program. [3] BrightMart plans to add ten more cities by the end of next year. [4]

questions.content: What is the press release mainly about?
questions.explanation: Thông cáo về dịch vụ giao hàng trong ngày – một lựa chọn vận chuyển nhanh hơn.

questions.content: What happened during the trial period?

options.C: The company hired a new CEO.

questions.explanation: '…during which online sales rose by 22 percent.'

questions.content: The word "addresses" in paragraph 2, line 4, is closest in meaning to
questions.explanation: 'This service addresses that need' = dịch vụ này giải quyết nhu cầu đó → deals with. Không phải nghĩa 'địa chỉ'.

questions.content:
In which of the positions marked [1], [2], [3], and [4] does the following sentence best belong?
"To qualify, the delivery address must be within 20 miles of a BrightMart store."
questions.explanation: Câu chèn nêu thêm điều kiện áp dụng dịch vụ, nối tiếp câu về thành phố và giờ đặt hàng → vị trí [1].

groups.passage:
Voyager Laptop Backpack – $89
Available colors: black, navy, gray, olive

• Fits laptops up to 16 inches
• Water-resistant fabric
• Hidden pocket for passport and cards
• Two-year warranty against manufacturing defects

Free shipping on orders over $75. Members of our Rewards Club earn double points on all bags this month.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

★★★☆☆ Great design, one problem
Posted by Kevin Walsh, April 18

I bought the navy Voyager backpack for my business trips, and I love the hidden pocket and the many compartments. My 15-inch laptop fits perfectly. However, after only three months, the zipper on the main compartment broke. I have contacted customer service and am waiting for a reply. I would give five stars if not for the zipper.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

To: Kevin Walsh
From: Trailhead Gear Customer Service
Date: April 20
Subject: Your Voyager backpack

Dear Mr. Walsh,

Thank you for contacting us, and we are sorry about the problem with your backpack. Since the item is covered by our warranty, we will send you a new backpack at no cost. Unfortunately, the color you purchased is currently out of stock. We can send you a black or gray backpack immediately, or you can wait about three weeks for the original color.

Please reply to let us know your preference. There is no need to return the damaged backpack.

Sincerely,
Ana Ruiz
Trailhead Gear

questions.content: What is NOT mentioned as a feature of the backpack?

options.D: It can hold a large laptop.

questions.explanation: Câu hỏi NOT: trang sản phẩm không nhắc tới bộ sạc tích hợp. Các ý còn lại đều có.

questions.content: What is suggested about Mr. Walsh?

options.C: He is a Rewards Club member.

questions.explanation: 'I bought the navy Voyager backpack for my business trips' → đi công tác. Laptop của anh 15 inch.

questions.content: Why is Mr. Walsh eligible for a replacement?

options.A: He is a Rewards Club member.
options.B: He returned the item within 30 days.
options.D: The problem is covered by a two-year guarantee.

questions.explanation: Khoá kéo hỏng sau 3 tháng – vẫn trong bảo hành 2 năm cho lỗi sản xuất (trang sản phẩm + e-mail 'covered by our warranty').

questions.content: What color is currently out of stock?
questions.explanation: E-mail: màu khách đã mua đang hết hàng; bài đánh giá cho biết anh mua màu navy → kết hợp hai đoạn.

questions.content: What does Ms. Ruiz ask Mr. Walsh to do?
questions.explanation: 'Please reply to let us know your preference.' (A) sai: 'There is no need to return the damaged backpack.'
